scope: Standing Hellenic Parliament in the former royal palace, including its exterior, roof voids and three entrance porticos.

references.caption: The Greek Parliament in Syntagma Square, Athens. 2006
references.alt: The Greek Parliament in Syntagma Square, Athens. 2006

originalReview.notes: The exact daytime view shows the standing Syntagma elevation, pale ochre tone, horizontal cornices, regular three-storey windows, open ground portico and upper central pediment.

The exact blue-hour view confirms the repeated rectangular bays, taller central window triplets, Doric colonnade composition, upper pediment and raised building terrace. Colors are guided by the daytime original.

quallaSearch.notes: The two exact Qualla originals show the standing west facade in daylight and blue hour. The Parliament’s official history describes the original wings, the 1930s installation of a north portico and the existing east and west porticos. The Syntagma memorial is independently mapped.
